output_contract.scientific_summary: One complete scientific summary.json updated per source-defined stage and on normal/exceptional return. The full small scientific summary and identity are included in the same attempt note.
output_contract.raw_fields: Full scientific data stay on the runner. Observe each whole NPZ byte size and SHA-256.
output_contract.live: the latest actual small stdout JSON line and complete per-candidate summary when available
output_contract.complete_log: every scientific stdout/stderr byte remains in the runner log with a final length and SHA
output_contract.publication: notes/run39-bent-body-killing-<actual_run>-<actual_attempt>.json and its own H marker after normal pull/rebase and capacity accounting
output_contract.normal_exhaustion_or_unsatisfied_targets: No conclusion of metric, reach, grip, global embedding or rigid-quotient success is inferred from the return code

direct_input_lineage: Direct mathematical reference and all material/physical settings come from immutable current and previously published source text, frozen in the trigger commit. Run38 numerical fields and Run37/36 points are independent historical results.
mathematical_boundary: Working source evaluations and finite grids have the meaning declared in the scientific program. Global isometry, fixed-target convergence, regular flow, closed C2 embedding, reach, held and Euclidean separation need evidence for the exact same material and actual physical point. No flow integration on the full material atlas is inferred from a fixed-time-zero metric or a six-phase image cloud.

scientific_parameter_summary.program: Five initial material vector solves, two complete joint layers in each of two geometry classes, and two same-source metric layers on the selected geometry. Up to eleven returned stages.
scientific_parameter_summary.frozen_target: induced Gram of the immutable true geometric source at its recorded selected physical coefficients and degree; both subsequent layers use the same full material target.
